design_description: A clean and modern white-based design with dark brown trims and side panels, giving the kit a refined yet grounded identity. The standout element is the large tonal gorilla illustration emerging from the lower side of the jersey, rendered in a faceted geometric style that blends aggression with elegance. Subtle claw marks reinforce the Macacos theme without overcrowding the composition. Overall, the design balances minimalism and power — calm from a distance, but intense and animalistic up close.
